close_reason: RoutingMailer with Selector (DomainGlob, MessageType, CatchAll), failover on transient failure, outbound_send_total{provider,result} Prometheus counter. 8 tests pass.
description:
## Why this issue exists

Phase 2 of epic stoa-y0p2j. RoutingMailer wraps an ordered list of (Selector, Arc<dyn OutboundMailer>) pairs and dispatches sends through the first healthy matching provider, falling over to the next on failure.

## What needs to be done

1. Define Selector enum: DomainGlob(String), MessageType(MessageType), CatchAll
2. Define MessageType enum: Transactional | Bulk | System
3. Implement RoutingMailer: Vec<(Selector, Arc<dyn OutboundMailer>)>
   - send(): find first matching selector whose provider is healthy; attempt; on failure try next matching entry
4. Add per-provider Prometheus counters: outbound_send_total{provider, result}
5. Emit tracing event with audit=true on delivery failure
6. Add config shape:
   [[delivery.route]]
   selector = { domain = "*.example.com" }
   provider = "ses-primary"
   [[delivery.route]]
   selector = "*"
   provider = "smtp-relay"
7. Unit tests: selector matching, failover to next provider, catch-all, metrics counters

## Acceptance criteria

- RoutingMailer selects by domain and message type
- Falls over to next matching entry on transient failure
- Per-provider outbound_send_total{provider, result} counter emitted
- cargo clippy clean, cargo test passes
title: Phase 2: RoutingMailer with failover and selector logic
